Key.Original: Log thermal diagnostics to the RPT, including the wall-clock cost of each thermal function. Turn this on before reporting a performance fault.
Key.English: Log thermal diagnostics to the RPT, including the wall-clock cost of each thermal function. Turn this on before reporting a performance fault.

Key.Original: Seconds between object-temperature scans. Surface temperatures change on time constants of 600 seconds and longer, so a scan every tick is wasted work. 0 scans every tick.
Key.English: Seconds between object-temperature scans. Surface temperatures change on time constants of 600 seconds and longer, so a scan every tick is wasted work. 0 scans every tick.

Key.Original: Thermal selections repainted per second. The engine re-uploads a procedural texture for each one, and that cost lands on the render thread where no script timer sees it. The physics still solves every pass, so the image gain and every thermal coupling are unaffected.
Key.English: Thermal selections repainted per second. The engine re-uploads a procedural texture for each one, and that cost lands on the render thread where no script timer sees it. The physics still solves every pass, so the image gain and every thermal coupling are unaffected.

Key.Original: Log thermal system diagnostics (second sun, building paint, AGC) to the RPT. Thermal's own debug flag - not nightvision's.
Key.English: Log thermal system diagnostics (second sun, building paint, AGC) to the RPT. Thermal's own debug flag - not nightvision's.

Key.Original: Add fixed-pattern noise (static spatial mottle) over painted thermal objects - the perlinNoise detail stage real LWIR sensors show on top of the temporal FilmGrain.
Key.English: Add fixed-pattern noise (static spatial mottle) over painted thermal objects - the perlinNoise detail stage real LWIR sensors show on top of the temporal FilmGrain.
Applies the five full-screen thermal effects: colour grade, black-hot inversion, sensor grain, IR-scatter blur and the ocular vignette. Turn OFF to isolate their render cost.

Key.Original: White hot (hot = white) is the system default (AN/PAS-13 initialises white hot). Black hot (hot = black) is a user-selectable alternative - FM 3-22.9 states polarity is user preference
Key.English: White hot (hot = white) is the system default (AN/PAS-13 initialises white hot). Black hot (hot = black) is a user-selectable alternative - FM 3-22.9 states polarity is user preference
